opening.argument: The presentation urges viewers to invest in OneCoin and earn, linking paid packages to tokens and token-splitting benefits. It promotes projected appreciation, including claims that the coin’s value could nearly double within months, alongside recruitment-based referral bonuses, matching bonuses, commissions, and start-up incentives. Package and estimated-profit tables reinforce that investment pitch, while bonus slides tie earnings to recruited members’ business volume and sales across generations. These features establish a scam promotion built around token purchases and anticipated profit. Although some examples are demonstrations and earning chances are acknowledged as potentially low, those qualifications remain within the same investment- and profit-oriented promotion.

citations.quote: Now is the time to invest in it and earn something.
